messages.content:
You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"For current API authentication and webhook-related setup, please use our GraphQL API v2 quickstart here: https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart; it reflects the current auth/header model we support now."

CONTEXT: {"user_request": "Email support@scaffold.dev a customer-safe replacement for the stale refund-webhook authentication macro, including the current documentation link.", "today": "2026-09-14", "tool": "send_email", "arguments": {"to": "support@scaffold.dev", "subject": "Replacement refund-webhook authentication macro", "body": "For current API authentication and webhook-related setup, please use our GraphQL API v2 quickstart here: https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart; it reflects the current auth/header model we support now."}, "field_being_checked": "result.body"}

CRITERION:
Provides customer-safe wording directing current API authentication and webhook setup questions to https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart as the supported current auth/header guidance. Recommending the legacy v1 refund-webhook path fails; merely quoting the correct link while recommending the wrong one is insufficient.

Return the JSON verdict now.

{"passed":true,"reason":"The body directs current API authentication and webhook setup to https://docs.atlas-test.com/api/v2/graphql-quickstart and explicitly says it reflects the currently supported auth/header model, without recommending the legacy v1 path."}
